intro.title: Offline Order Queue
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build an offline order queue for a mobile app, allowing users to place orders even without an internet connection. You will learn how to use Ionic Storage to save order data locally on the device and manage a queue of pending orders. The core programming concept involves storing and retrieving data from local storage, and updating the UI to reflect the queue's status. You'll use Ionic, Angular, and Capacitor to create a functional feature that enhances app reliability and user experience.
intro.usecase: An offline order queue is essential for mobile point-of-sale systems used by delivery drivers, field sales representatives, and retail staff in areas with unreliable connectivity. When a user takes an order in a coffee shop with spotty Wi-Fi or processes a payment in a remote warehouse, the app stores these transactions locally and syncs them automatically when network connection is restored. This pattern prevents data loss, maintains business continuity, and provides a seamless user experience in critical mobile workflows where every transaction matters.
